mapper.select: SELECT yh.CORP_GR, TO_CHAR(yh.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd, yh.TR_CD, yh.FUND_CD, yh.TR_CO_CD, yh.TRUSTEE, yh.JM_CD AS yj_cd, yh.TR_SEQ, yh.CURRENCY, yh.GYULJE_AEK, yh.TRANS_RT, yh.WON_GYULJE_AEK, TO_CHAR(yh.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd, ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd, F_JM_NM(yh.CORP_GR, yh.JM_CD) AS xx_yj_cd, ia.FUND_CURRENCY, yh.FCUR_GYULJE_AEK, yh.KSD_JM_CD, jm.JM_NM AS xx_ksd_jm_cd, 1 AS p_visible FROM SYT0YH yh JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = yh.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = yh.FUND_CD LEFT JOIN OTS0JM jm ON jm.CORP_GR = yh.CORP_GR AND jm.JM_CD = yh.KSD_JM_CD WHERE yh.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yh.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND yh.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY yh.FUND_CD, yh.TRUSTEE, yh.JM_CD
SELECT NVL(MAX(TR_SEQ), 0) FROM SYT0YH WHERE CORP_GR=#{corpGr} AND TR_YMD=TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TR_CD=#{trCd}
SELECT CURRENCY FROM SYX2MM WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND TRUSTEE = #{trustee} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT BANK_CD FROM SZX2MM WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND TR_CO_CD = #{trustee} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYT0YH (CORP_GR, TR_YMD, TR_CD, FUND_CD, TR_CO_CD, TRUSTEE, JM_CD, TR_SEQ, CURRENCY, GYULJE_AEK, TRANS_RT, WON_GYULJE_AEK, GYULJE_YMD, FCUR_GYULJE_AEK, KSD_JM_CD) VALUES (#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{trCd}, #{fundCd}, #{trCoCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trustee,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{yjCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trSeq}, #{currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{gyuljeAek},0), NVL(#{transRt},0), NVL(#{wonGyuljeAek},0), TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{gyuljeYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{fcurGyuljeAek,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ksdJmCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SYT0YH WHERE CORP_GR=#{corpGr} AND TR_YMD=TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{trYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TR_CD=#{trCd} AND FUND_CD=#{fundCd} AND TR_SEQ=#{trSeq}
